correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact published formulas U'(y)=(e^y-1)/(q e^y-p), W(E)=(q-p)log r and Theta(E)=(q-p)^(-1) integral W'(x)/sqrt(e^{2(E-x)}-1) dx, local analytic series reversion gives the inverse coefficients through order seven. Beta convolution gives c1=pi A/(12 d^(3/2)), c2=pi A^2/(576 d^(5/2)), and on A=0, c3=pi(d-4)(d-1)^2/(720 sqrt d). Since E=d(log r)^2/8+O((log r)^4), composition gives the claimed coefficient. The checker reconstructs these identities from the defining formulas rather than trusting stored coefficients.
